key_insight: Classical Houdayer cluster updates amplify the diversity of quantum-generated maximum independent set solutions by up to 11,923×, with a median gain of 24.3×.
engineering_relevance: Post-processing can extract more distinct optimal configurations—and sometimes larger independent sets—from existing Rydberg-array measurements without additional quantum sampling.
method: Seed solution sets with measurements from QuEra’s Aquila analog quantum device.
Apply classical Houdayer cluster updates to expand the sampled solution sets.
Measure diversity amplification and manifold coverage against known exact ground-state degeneracies.
evidence_signal: Across 43 problem instances, post-processing recovered a median 21% of the ground-state manifold and provably recovered all ground states for six instances.
watch_item: The update method is non-ergodic, so complete ground-state manifold coverage is not guaranteed.
paper_title: Efficient Ground-State Manifold Amplification for Rydberg Atom Arrays via Houdayer Cluster Updates
